svg.title: Legal Operations Assistant — current RAG architecture
svg.desc: Manual indexing, hybrid BM25 and Chroma retrieval, evidence grading, cited draft generation, citation and claim validation, Legal fallback and request state.
svg.text: LangGraph: retrieve → grade → generate draft → validate → answer or escalate
Normal generated-response path: 3 LLM calls on Nebius · Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 · temperature 0
Fictional JSON / PDF → validate → section/sentence chunks (220 tokens; overlap ≤40) → MiniLM → Chroma
Manual index refresh · source/page metadata retained · BM25 built from active passages and reused in memory
IDs must belong to selected evidence
One call · no retries or correction loop
Failed evidence, citations, claims or processing → safe fallback
CONTACT LEGAL — FIXED MESSAGE, NO EXTRA LLM CALL
Withhold rejected draft · record escalation reason · prepare local handoff packet
The application does not notify Legal or grant approvals automatically.
Action + decision / escalation reason + failed stage + timings
Fresh state per question; session chat is not a persistent audit log or model memory.
• Model checks reduce risk, not guarantee correctness
Code map: knowledge_base.py + chunking.py | retriever.py | bot.py | workflow.py | app.py / app_pages
Current implementation · Fictional ExampleCo corpus · Claim timeout defaults to 10 s (SDK network timeout, not a whole-request deadline)
